# native-alac-v1

This corpus fixes the stable, in-process MP4/M4A + ALAC route. Every ALAC
fixture has a deterministic WAV twin containing identical integer PCM. The
manifest records byte hashes, geometry, encoder identity, twin relationships,
and normalized interleaved `f64` fingerprints.

Normal tests consume the committed bytes and do not require FFmpeg. Exact
regeneration is deliberately pinned to FFmpeg 8.0.1:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate-native-alac-v1.py --check
```

The samples are synthetic, generated by this MIT-licensed repository, and do
not contain personal or copyrighted recordings.
